texts.preamble: M/S. Adani Wilmar Ltd vs Sri Satyajit Patel And Another .... Opp. ... on 22 February, 2024 Author: A.K. Mohapatra Bench: A.K. Mohapatra In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack Crlmc No.1264 of 2016 M/s. Adani Wilmar Ltd. .... Petitioner Mr. Sumit Lal, Advocate -versus- Sri Satyajit Patel and another .... Opp. Parties Mr. A.P. Das, A.S.C. Coram: Justice A.K. Mohapatra Order Order No. 22.02.2024 I.A. No.3583 of 2023 13. 1.
texts.facts: This interlocutory application has been filed by the Petitioner for amendment of the cause title of the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. as per the schedule of amendment sought.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that prosecution report under Annexure-1 reveals that in Case No.03 dated 29.10.2007, which has been registered under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, the State-Opposite Party has narrated as a party represented by one Sri Satyajit Patel, I/c. Food Inspector, Subarnapur. He further submitted that while filing petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. inadvertently the Petitioner has arrayed the Food Inspector, Subarnapur by his name as Opposite Party and the // 2 // original accused as Opposite Party No.2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contended that the Petitioner-Company was subsequently added as an accused in the 2(C)CC No.5 of 2007, out of which, the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. arises. 4.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contended that the Petitioner-Company was subsequently added as an accused in the 2(C)CC No.5 of 2007, out of which, the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. arises. 4.
